newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecommunications bill clears lower house.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecommunications bill clears lower house.

text.p: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies completed voting on amendments to a new telecommunications bill Thursday, allowing the legislation to advance to the Senate, an official said.
The lower house of Congress voted on more than 100 amendments to the bill which will regulate the telecommunications sector and lay down rules for the privatization of the Telebras system.

The bill remains virtually unchanged from a draft version drawn up by Deputy Alberto Goldman, which does not set limits on foreign capital but allows Brazil's president to fix limits on a case-by-case basis.
The bill also creates a new regulator for the sector and sets down rules for private operators.
